Kingdom.name: {=kingdom_equestria}Solar Equestria
Kingdom.title: {=kingdom_equestria_title}Solar Equestria
Kingdom.text: {=kingdom_equestria_text}The heart of Equestria under Princess Celestia, who raises the sun. Canterlot, the old nobility and the Royal Guard — the oldest and proudest of the four Equestrias.

Kingdom.name: {=kingdom_lunar}Lunar Equestria
Kingdom.title: {=kingdom_lunar_title}Lunar Equestria
Kingdom.text: {=kingdom_lunar_text}Princess Luna's western lands: cities of night lights, the thestrals of the Night Guard and heroes of old returned from Limbo. Here the night is not a time of fear but of dreams.

Kingdom.name: {=kingdom_friendship}Equestria of Friendship
Kingdom.title: {=kingdom_friendship_title}Equestria of Friendship
Kingdom.text: {=kingdom_friendship_text}The lands of Princess Twilight and the Elements of Harmony: Ponyville, the Castle of Friendship and the busy cities of the east coast. Here they believe friendship is stronger than any army — and keep an army all the same.

Kingdom.name: {=kingdom_crystal}Crystal Empire
Kingdom.title: {=kingdom_crystal_title}Crystal Empire
Kingdom.text: {=kingdom_crystal_text}The northern empire of the crystal ponies under Princess Cadance, ally of Equestria. While the Crystal Heart stands, Sombra's cold and darkness will not return.

Kingdom.name: {=kingdom_griffonia}Griffonstone
Kingdom.title: {=kingdom_griffonia_title}Kingdom Griffonstone
Kingdom.text: {=kingdom_griffonia_text}The mountain kingdom of the gryphons, which once lost everything with the Idol of Boreas. The Idol is back now, and the gryphons are learning to be loyal as well as greedy.

Kingdom.name: {=kingdom_hippogriffia}Hippogriffia
Kingdom.title: {=kingdom_hippogriffia_title}Kingdom of Mount Aris
Kingdom.text: {=kingdom_hippogriffia_text}The hippogriffs of Mount Aris and the seaponies of Seaquestria. Once they hid from the Storm King beneath the waves; now they fly over their western shore again.

Kingdom.name: {=kingdom_olenia}Olenia
Kingdom.title: {=kingdom_olenia_title}Kingdom of Olenia
Kingdom.text: {=kingdom_olenia_text}The northern woods and lakes of the deer. A bastard holds the throne, the rightful heir gathers her supporters, and antlered levies watch the border against the dragons.

Kingdom.name: {=kingdom_dragons}Dragon Lands
Kingdom.title: {=kingdom_dragons_title}Dragon Lands
Kingdom.text: {=kingdom_dragons_text}The scorched south-east of volcanoes and jungle. Dragons respect only strength, but their Dragon Lord Ember is learning that friendship has claws too.

Kingdom.name: {=kingdom_yakyakistan}Yakyakistan
Kingdom.title: {=kingdom_yakyakistan_title}Tsarstvo Yakyakistan
Kingdom.text: {=kingdom_yakyakistan_text}The mountain realm of the yaks. Here they prize plain speech, hard frost and the knack of smashing whatever was done wrong.

Kingdom.name: {=kingdom_changeling}Changeling Lands
Kingdom.title: {=kingdom_changeling_title}Hive changelings
Kingdom.text: {=kingdom_changeling_text}The barren south-east, riddled with the hives of the shapeshifters. They feed on the love of others and are preparing a march on their neighbours.
